svg.title: Architecture of the Autonomous ML Engineer Crew
svg.text: uploads a CSV, picks the column
live stage progress, 7 result tabs, predict form,
runs the Flow in a worker thread
one shared PipelineState (Pydantic) travels through every stage
retry with the evaluator's feedback · max 2 retries
retry with the evaluator's feedback · max 2 retries
Every hand-off is a validated Pydantic
contract; a bad payload stops the run.
Every run ends in exactly one state:
class balance, leakage hints, file hash
raw rows never reach an LLM;
result is checked against a contract
before the agent may use it
tries each source in order and records which one answered
one run per candidate model with
params and metrics; the winner is
one trace per pipeline run, across
